item.description: About this WebinarTurn Yield Excursions into Faster,更自信的根本原因分析当良率问题出现时，答案很少存在于单一系统中。 Critical clues are spread across metrology data, tool traces, chemical analysis, and facilities systems, while growing data volumes make traditional dashboards slow, fragmented, and difficult to act on.What You’ll Learn:Discover how a purpose-built semiconductor analytics platform can help engineers connect insights across domains without moving data. See how Agentic AI, semiconductor-specific visualizations, and push-down compute enable faster investigation of yield excursions and process issues, even across billions of data points. In the session, a live demonstration shows how to conduct a multi-domain root cause investigation using Spotfire® Industry Pro.Key Takeaways:Understand why siloed manufacturing data delays yield recovery and inflates costsLearn how Agentic AI automates complex cross-domain analytics and visualization generationExplore methods for scaling high-performance analytics across massive fab数据集谁应该参加：产量、工艺和集成工程师； Fab and Manufacturing Operations Managers; Quality and Reliability Engineers; and Data & Analytics leaders supporting wafer fabs, foundries, OSATs, and IDMs who need to identify issues faster while maintaining confidence in decision-making.Save Your Spot!Join this webinar to learn how leading semiconductor teams are accelerating root cause investigations, scaling analytics across massive datasets, and transforming disconnected data into actionable manufacturing intelligence. item.description: 本报告探讨了研发浪费以及人工智能的采用如何超越了做出相应决策所需的情报好吧。与会者将学到什么研发预算在哪里损失。超过三分之一的组织将 25% 到 40% 的研发预算用于从未进入市场的项目。为什么项目迟到会失败。几乎一半的团队估计，在开发或测试期间终止的每个项目都会浪费超过 100 万美元的投资。为什么人工智能的采用并没有缩小这一差距。大多数组织将人工智能应用于数据分析和建模等执行任务，而不是决策支持。智能最重要。受访者表示，在投入大量资金之前，更好地获取情报对于早期构思和可行性具有最大价值。立即下载这份免费白皮书！
